description.value: Szechuan Chili Restaurant has been serving bold, spice-forward Szechuan cuisine on Vancouver's West 6th Avenue since 2001. Signature dishes include Dry Szechuan Chili Ginger Beef, General Tso's Chicken, and a wide range of dumplings and noodle dishes. The restaurant offers both dine-in and online ordering with pickup, and also provides catering services.
